newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ugine buys German stainless steel firm.
newsitem.headline: Ugine buys German stainless steel firm.

text.p: Usinor Sacilor said on Wednesday that stainless steel unit Ugine has acquired 100 percent of Rosfrei Coil Center (RCC), one of the main stainless steel processor in Germany, for an undisclosed amount.
Usinor said in a statement the transaction was made through Ugine's German subsidiary, Ugine Edelstahl.
RCC processes some 40,000 tonnes of cold-rolled flat products each year.
"The transacton allows Ugine to strengthen its presence and improve service in the number one European market for cold-rolled stainless steel, valued at 650,000 tonnes per year," the statement said.
